description: Accept another time the business proposed for a booking, its quote, its changes to an order, or a change it asks for to a confirmed booking or an accepted order (offer.kind change: the promise moves). This binds your person, so send terms_sha — offer.terms_sha from get_item_status — only after they said yes to offer.human, and offer_id (offer.id) so an answer to an offer since replaced does nothing. Without terms_sha nothing is booked: you get the terms to show them. An accepted quote becomes a confirmed booking or order (linked). A yes to a change that can no longer be made online goes to a person there instead (passed_on), and what was agreed stands.

access_token.description: Capability secret returned when the item was created without an account.

idempotency_key.description: Same key + same request = same answer. Required for agents.

key.description: The person's key (sdkey1_…), if that is all you have: it is exchanged once for a pass, which comes back in identity.passes — keep the pass and send it next time instead. Never stored.

offer_id.description: The offer you answer: offer.id from get_item_status. If the business has replaced it since, nothing is done (409 offer_changed, with the current one).

pass.description: The person's passes (sdpass1_…), space-separated, at most 8: presented to the network that issued each, so the business recognises the customer. Or send them in the Sdi-Pass header. Never stored.

terms_sha.description: The fingerprint of the terms your person said yes to: offer.terms_sha from get_item_status. Leave it out to be told the terms first; nothing is booked without it.

name: accept_offer
title: Accept what the business proposed
